# Playground tracks

<!-- generated by scripts/generators/sync-playground-track-map.py; edit the graph/classifier, then regenerate -->

The playground is one repository with many small tracks. The goal is to
organize intentional defects and repair lessons while assigning every p101
wrapper exactly one curriculum home. Correct programs live in examples/.

## Coverage

- Wrappers assigned to a track: `1237`
- Unassigned wrappers/domains: `0`
- Tracks linked to canonical correct examples: `8`
- Track count: `40`
- Orientation pre-track: `00-p101-orientation`
- Misc tracks/domains are intentionally forbidden.

## How to use this

Each track owns a defect family, diagnostic route, and repair sequence.
The local executable is only an inventory/linkage harness. It is never
the canonical good path and is never counted as behavior coverage.
Correct examples live in the owning examples/<repo> repository and are
linked rather than copied into the playground.

Regenerate after changing wrapper libraries or graph classification:

```sh
../../scripts/generators/analyze-lib-function-graph.py
../../scripts/generators/sync-playground-track-map.py
```
